finding: 0800ebec (FunctionHead_0800ebec) is the head of one large C function that continues, with the same live stack frame and register file, through sub_0800ee14 (Region_0800ee14, reached by plain 'bne', not 'bl') and on through sub_0800ef44/sub_0800f092/sub_0800f0c6 into sub_0800f1fa (Fragment_0800f1fa, reached by a 'mov r12,pc / bx r4' veneer hop), whose epilogue ('pop {r3,r5,r6,r7}; mov r8,r3; ...; pop {r1}; bx r1') is the only return path and restores exactly the registers FunctionHead_0800ebec's prologue saved. Total span is roughly 0800ebec-0800f2e0, about 1.8KB. This matches the sibling finding already recorded for 0800ee14 (games/gs1/recon/en/main/0800ee14.json): no ordinary standalone C function can reproduce a mid-function branch target with a live caller-established frame, so 0800ee14/0800ef44/0800f0c6/0800f1fa cannot be scored as separate owners, and 0800ebec cannot be adopted as a 552-byte owner either, because its C body does not actually end at 0800ee14 - it is the same function.
